tldr: 台股週五收在歷史新高 46,551 點、大漲 693 點（+1.51%），台積電重返 2,400 元之上，AI 硬體供應鏈領漲。
法人預估台灣企業 2026 年獲利成長約 50%，約為先前 18% 預估值的三倍，AI 熱潮為主要動能。
金管會持續引導壽險資金投入國內基建與策略產業，財管業則力推另類資產與家族辦公室服務。

items.title_zh: 台股收盤創歷史新高、量能撐盤
items.title_en: TAIEX closes at record high heading into the weekend
items.summary_zh: 最近交易日加權指數收 46,551.13 點、上漲 693.47 點（+1.51%），成交約 8,271 億元；台積電漲 0.84% 至 2,410 元，指數重返 5 日線。市場關注量能能否推升突破 46,600～47,000 點壓力區，短線多方氣勢延續。
items.summary_en: In the latest session the TAIEX added 693.47 points (+1.51%) to a record 46,551.13, with turnover near NT$827bn. TSMC rose 0.84% to NT$2,410, and the index reclaimed its 5-day line; traders now watch whether volume can carry it past the 46,600–47,000 zone.
items.source_name: 新光證券 台股盤後 2026/09/04

items.title_zh: 台企獲利估增約 50%、AI 撐評價
items.title_en: Taiwan Inc. profit growth seen near 50% on AI
items.summary_zh: 市場預估台灣企業 2026 年獲利成長上看 50%，接近 2025 年底 18% 預估的三倍，AI 需求帶動硬體供應鏈。獲利上修支撐台股評價，半導體與 AI 伺服器續為盤面主軸，資金聚焦具實質訂單的族群。
items.summary_en: Forecasts now put 2026 corporate earnings growth around 50%, close to triple the 18% expected at end-2025, as AI demand lifts the hardware supply chain. The upgrade underpins the equity rally and keeps semiconductors and AI servers the market's dominant theme.

items.title_zh: 全球半導體 2026 年營收上看 1 兆美元
items.title_en: Global chip revenue seen topping US$1tn in 2026
items.summary_zh: 法人預估 2026 年全球半導體營收首度突破 1 兆美元，AI 需求驅動業者加碼資本支出：日月光投控 2026 年資本支出增 20 億美元至 105 億美元，南亞科上限拉高至近 700 億元台幣。台灣被點名為亞太 AI 基建最大受惠市場。
items.summary_en: Analysts project worldwide semiconductor revenue to break US$1 trillion for the first time in 2026 on AI demand, prompting fresh capex: ASE lifted its 2026 budget by US$2bn to US$10.5bn and Nanya raised its cap toward NT$70bn. Taiwan is repeatedly named the top AI-infrastructure beneficiary in Asia-Pacific.

items.title_zh: 傳動元件受惠半導體與機器人雙題材
items.title_en: Motion components ride semiconductor and robotics themes
items.summary_zh: 半導體設備與 AI 機器人需求同步升溫，上銀、大銀微系統等傳動元件廠受市場點名，台灣機械出口大幅成長。雙題材帶動資金由大型晶片股向精密零組件族群輪動，題材延續性受關注。
items.summary_en: Transmission and motion-component makers such as Hiwin and Mega-Fabs are in focus as semiconductor equipment and AI-driven robotics demand converge, with Taiwan machinery exports reported up sharply. The dual theme is drawing rotation into precision-component names beyond the large-cap chip leaders.

items.title_zh: 金管會開放壽險投資 AI 新十大建設策略產業
items.title_en: FSC opens insurer investment in strategic AI-build industries
items.summary_zh: 金管會放寬保險業投資「AI 新十大建設推動方案」策略性產業，並鬆綁對國內私募股權基金投資限額，引導壽險資金投入公共建設與實體產業，同時兼顧保戶權益與投資風險控管。
items.summary_en: The FSC has widened rules letting insurers invest in strategic industries under the "New Ten Major AI Infrastructure" plan and eased limits on domestic private-equity fund allocations, aiming to channel life-insurance capital into public construction and the real economy while safeguarding policyholders.

items.title_zh: 接軌新清償制度、金控資本減壓
items.title_en: Capital-adequacy transition eases pressure on financial holdings
items.summary_zh: 配合接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS），金管會金控合併資本適足性辦法修正草案給予監理彈性，協助 8 家壽險型金控資本減壓，並讓 11 家保險型金控 CAR 申報延後一個月，以利新舊制平順交替。
items.summary_en: Under the shift to the new TIS solvency regime, the FSC's draft on group capital-adequacy rules gives supervisory flexibility—cutting capital strain for eight life-insurance-type FHCs and letting eleven insurance-type FHCs defer CAR filing by a month—to smooth the old-to-new framework changeover.

items.title_zh: 銀行看好私募與家族辦公室、拓另類資產
items.title_en: Banks push alternatives and family offices for HNW clients
items.summary_zh: 2026 亞資高峰論壇上，銀行業認為高資產客戶需要的是整合式財管服務而非更多商品，籲擴大私募股權、私募債權、避險基金及家族辦公室（EAM）布局，並深化跨境財管，呼應台灣打造亞洲資產管理中心方向。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Asia asset forum, bankers argued high-net-worth clients need integrated wealth solutions rather than more products, urging wider allocation to private equity, private credit, hedge funds and family-office (EAM) services, plus deeper cross-border wealth management as Taiwan builds out an asset-management hub.

items.title_zh: 存股族續抱高息 ETF、聚焦配息
items.title_en: Dividend ETFs stay core holdings for savers
items.summary_zh: 0050、00919、00878 等市值型與高股息 ETF 仍是台灣存股族最愛，投資人關注配息、成分股與殖利率表現。資金穩定流入顯示散戶對收益型、分散式股票配置的需求延續，題材與定期定額買盤同步支撐。
items.summary_en: High-dividend and market ETFs such as 0050, 00919 and 00878 remain the most-held names among Taiwan's "stock-saving" investors, with attention on payout rates, holdings and yields. Steady inflows into these products underline retail demand for income-oriented, diversified equity exposure.
